world.tone: Dark sword-and-sorcery fantasy. Mercenaries, bounties and old grudges; steel and spellcraft collide on a candlelit frontier where one wrong word ends in bloodshed.
world.background: The crown is weak and the borderlands are lawless. Mages raise mana shields against blades and call down fire and lightning, but every spell needs a moment of focus and their mana runs out. Knights in heavy plate shrug off most weapons, yet they are slow and cumbersome, and their joints and visors are weak points. Healing magic is rare; internal wounds and spell backlash are slow to heal. The Cathedral commands the land through holy oaths and edicts, but it hides its own rot. Mercenaries and bounty hunters run the border towns, where coin, lives and old debts often trade at par.
laws: A mage can raise a 'mana shield' that stops ordinary blades; while the shield holds, ordinary attacks barely touch the mage, but armor-piercing weapons, penetrating spells or repeated heavy blows can shatter it.

Heavy plate turns aside cuts and blunt blows to the torso, but it is slow and clumsy: moving and turning take time, and joints, gaps and the visor are weak points. Lightning magic, blunt force and precise thrusts can hurt through the armor.
Casting requires a brief moment of focus (an interruption or a serious wound makes the spell collapse); mana is limited and runs dry under repeated casting.
Swift, agile fighters can close distance or slip away in an instant; slow ones cannot catch them or escape them.
Leverage beats brute force: blackmail, hostages, the truth or a holy oath can win without a fight, and can even turn an enemy into a friend.

scene.location: The Broken Sword Inn, late at night. The hearth is dying, long tables fill the room, the bar is on the west side, and the only wooden door is behind you.
scene.hook: You and Livia are talking quietly by the hearth when the inn door is kicked open. A knight in heavy plate steps in carrying a greatsword, his voice muffled by the visor: 'Seran. Hand over the Rift Codex, or leave your life here.'

player.name: Seran
player.backstory: A mercenary swordsman drifting along the frontier, in his early thirties, with an old war wound in his left arm. He once served the Cathedral, left after growing suspicious about an old massacre of a whole family, and has been on the run ever since, carrying the Rift Codex.
player.directive: Never abandon Livia to save yourself; become especially wary and distrustful whenever the Cathedral is mentioned.
player.voice: Few words, all of them precise; calm and restrained, speaks only when it matters.
player.motive: Find the real culprit behind the old massacre and protect the codex and his companion; escape if he can.
tactics: use the environment and people's motives
talk while talking works; fight only when it breaks down
abilities: soldier's swordplay, precise and brutal up close
keeps his head in a crisis
defenses: a hardened veteran who rarely loses his composure
weaknesses: old left-arm wound gives out under heavy strain or in a long fight
protective to a fault: he will take risks to save Livia if she is in danger

livia.name: Livia
livia.backstory: A traveling scholar-mage in her early twenties, carrying a staff and a pouch of spell scrolls. She has traveled with Seran for half a year, trusts him, and wants to test the ancient magic described in the codex.
livia.directive: Always speak a short incantation before casting, exposing the moment of focus; never be the first to harm an innocent.
livia.voice: Talks fast, loves jargon and wisecracks, and gets even chattier when nervous.
livia.motive: Protect Seran and the codex, and verify the ancient magic it describes.
tactics: create confusion with fog and illusions
step in front of a companion at the critical moment
abilities: reads ancient scripts and understands magical theory
defenses: mana shield stops ordinary blades (while it holds)
weaknesses: casting needs a moment of focus; if interrupted, the spell collapses
limited mana runs dry under repeated casting, and the shield thins with it

knight.name: Gareth
knight.backstory: A heavily armored knight sent by the Cathedral, around forty, who never removes his visor. His family was wiped out years ago in a so-called 'heresy' case. He has orders to recover the Rift Codex and deal with everyone connected to it, and believes he is doing heaven's work.
knight.directive: Once he picks a target, he pursues it relentlessly; he cannot stand anyone excusing the Cathedral unless hard proof is in front of him.
knight.voice: Muffled through the visor, every word like iron; he opens with 'hand over the codex' and the old case.
knight.motive: Take back the Rift Codex and finish whoever carries it, even if it means wrecking the inn and hurting bystanders.
tactics: block the exits and attack head-on
trade heavy blows with the greatsword and press in close
lean on the old case and the Cathedral's authority
abilities: armored charges that cut off escape routes
seasoned, cunning in a drawn-out fight
defenses: full plate: ordinary blades and clubs barely hurt his torso
weaknesses: heavy armor makes him slow; joints, gaps and the visor are weak points (lightning, blunt force and precise thrusts get through)
if he comes to believe he has been hunting the wrong culprit, his resolve to kill wavers and his attacks turn wild and undisciplined

marta.name: Marta
marta.backstory: Owner of the Broken Sword Inn, in her early fifties, sharp-tongued and shrewd. She has run the place on the frontier for years, avoids crossing either the law or the outlaws, and cares only about silver and her own roof.
marta.directive: Protect the inn and herself first; never risk her neck for either side for free. She only helps or points the way if the price is right.
marta.voice: Loud and streetwise, always talking business and house rules; her tune changes with her interests.
marta.motive: Keep the inn from being wrecked and herself alive, and ideally profit from the chaos.
tactics: smooth things over and stay on everyone's good side
bargain with drinks, intel and the back door
if things go badly, hide behind the bar or shout for the town guard
abilities: well-informed and a good judge of people
a loaded crossbow hidden under the bar
knows every hidden passage in the inn
defenses: an old hand who is hard to bluff
weaknesses: greedy: can be bought with silver or a promise to cover damages
afraid for the inn and of having blood on her hands; folds when scared

player.posture: Standing by the hearth, turned sideways toward the door

conditions.content: Old war wound in the left arm aches; it gives out in a long fight or under a heavy blow
conditions.gates: If the left arm takes heavy strain, or after several rounds of close fighting, its strikes suddenly lose strength

scroll.name: Rift Codex
traits: hard evidence in the old massacre case

carried.content: A spare dagger is sewn into the lining of his cloak
carried.gates: Can be drawn suddenly at close range; opponents rarely see it coming

livia.posture: Half a step behind Seran, staff in hand

conditions.content: Mana is fairly full, but only enough for two or three rounds of continuous casting
conditions.gates: After repeated casting her mana runs low and the shield thins; once drained, she cannot cast again for several rounds

staff.name: Staff
traits: a fire crystal set in its tip

scrolls.name: Scroll pouch
traits: a few single-use scrolls: fog, slow

knight.posture: Standing just inside the kicked-in door, greatsword angled at the floor, blocking the only exit

status_effects.content: Wearing full heavy plate; slow and cumbersome
status_effects.gates: Slow to move and turn; his back, flanks and armor joints are weak points

greatsword.name: Greatsword
greatsword.location: held at an angle in both hands

marta.posture: Crouched behind the bar on the west side, one hand already reaching under the counter

coinbox.name: Cash box
coinbox.location: at her feet behind the bar

spatial.content: Gareth is blocking the kicked-in door, the only visible exit
spatial.gates: Anyone escaping through the door has to get past Gareth first

spatial.content: Long tables and the dying hearth fill the middle of the room; the bar is on the west side
spatial.gates: Tables can be flipped for cover and the hearth provides open flame; behind the bar is Marta's territory

spatial.content: The back room has a hidden door to the stable, known only to Marta and regulars
spatial.gates: With Marta's consent, or under pressure, it offers another way out

scene_facts.content: A few old weapons waiting for repair hang on the wall, within reach
scene_facts.gates: Can be grabbed and used as weapons

scene_facts.content: The hearth and the oil lamps on the beams are lit, flames flickering in the draft
scene_facts.gates: Open flame is available: fire attacks, lighting the liquor barrels, scaring someone off

scene_facts.content: Several barrels of strong liquor are stacked in the corner, not far from the hearth
scene_facts.gates: Spilled and lit, they become a sea of fire; they are also leverage against Marta

scene_facts.content: The door was just kicked in; splinters and dust are still swirling in the doorway
scene_facts.gates: Visibility at the door is briefly poor; someone could use the confusion to rush in or slip out

social_facts.content: Gareth has been hunting the Rift Codex on the Cathedral's orders for half a year; tonight he has come to the door demanding the codex or a life
social_facts.gates: He has a legitimate mandate; defusing him or fighting him will both change the situation

social_facts.content: Seran carries the Rift Codex that Gareth is determined to take
social_facts.gates: The codex is both leverage and a liability; if it is damaged or taken, that leverage is lost

social_facts.content: Seran and Livia have a standing understanding: if a fight breaks out, Livia lays down fog first and Seran uses the cover to rush the door
social_facts.gates: The allies can coordinate on this; if it is seen through, it no longer works

social_facts.content: (Truth) The Cathedral bishop who ordered the hunt is the real culprit who wiped out Gareth's family and framed someone else; the Rift Codex contains the proof. Gareth is hunting the wrong person.
social_facts.gates: If revealed and Gareth is convinced, his resolve to kill wavers and he may even switch sides (enemy -> neutral/ally); this is the key to turning him, and the allies' last card

plans: If it comes to a fight, Livia lays down fog to disrupt the enemy and Seran uses the confusion to break for the door; do not reveal the truth in the codex unless there is no other choice, since it is the last card for shaking Gareth's resolve
